g.text: /auth itself — those 6 routes carry no token
None — the middleware never queries MongoDB
req.userId, set once from the token's _id claim
DECODED CLAIMS ARE TRUSTED, NOT RE-VERIFIED
A deleted user's still-unexpired token verifies successfully here — user existence is never re-checked.

svg.text: This is an internal flow, not an endpoint — it runs inside every protected request already documented in the other six modules.
